about.title: Technology as a cognitive safeguard
about.p1: At <0>VayuLab</0>, we see technology not as a substitute for the mind, but as a cognitive safeguard: we design solutions that protect clarity and strengthen analytical resilience.
about.p2: Accelerated automation must not cost the authority of thought. That is why we preserve the human capacity to judge, weigh and decide responsibly.

meditary.title: Meditary
meditary.description: A sustained-attention practice journal. Meditary is an example of our approach: a tool that gives focus and clarity back to its user, without deciding for anyone.
meditary.feature1_desc: Identify concentration patterns with data that supports your own judgment.
meditary.feature2_desc: A lean experience that isolates what matters and returns time for reflection.

pillars.title: Communication Pillars
pillars.subtitle: Three principles that guide every architecture we design.
pillars.autonomy_desc: Systems designed on the human-in-the-loop model, where data processing serves to support human intuition, never to override it.
pillars.noise_desc: Architectures designed to isolate relevant signals in information-saturated environments, giving time and focus back to strategic reflection.
pillars.sovereignty_desc: Shielding against automation bias, ensuring that final control and ethical responsibility remain non-negotiably with those who lead.

footer.tagline: VayuLab — Defending human discernment is our architecture.
